Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

' Hand-written synthetic module for the synth tests (a made-up widget shop).
Public Enum enumKind
    kAll = 0
    kRetail = 1
    kTrade = 2
    kStaff = 3
End Enum

Public Enum enumSettings
    stTaxRate = 1
    stLastRun = 3
End Enum

Public Sub MarkRush(ByVal lngOrderID As Long)
10      If Me.Priority = 3 Then Exit Sub   ' a commented literal: Priority = 99
20      Me.Filter = "Priority = 5"
30      strWhere = "Region = " & Me.txtRegion
40      If Me.KindID = enumKind.kTrade Then MsgBox "Trade customer"
50      If Err.Description = "Widget not found" Then Exit Sub
End Sub

Public Function GetSetting(ByVal lngID As enumSettings) As Variant
        Dim v As Variant
10      v = DLookup("SettingValue", "Settings", "SettingID = " & lngID)
20      Select Case lngID
            Case enumSettings.stTaxRate
30              v = CSng(v / 1000)   ' a whole number of thousandths
            Case stLastRun
40              v = CDate(v)
            Case Else
50              v = Null
60      End Select
70      GetSetting = v
End Function
